propositions: Missing or empty JIRA_PAT environment variable causes the client to silently fall back to anonymous access instead of failing with a named error
The documented security guarantee states that missing JIRA_PAT fails with an error naming the variable, but this is not enforced in the code path
An empty PAT is passed as the bearer token to the Jira client, resulting in anonymous requests that mislead operators with incorrect error messages like 'project does not exist'
Settings resolution must remain total (not raise on missing credential) to avoid breaking Python 3.11 Protocol conformance checks via hasattr inspection
Client construction must validate the PAT is non-empty and non-whitespace before creating the Jira client, failing with an error that explicitly names JIRA_PAT and the anonymous-fallback consequence
